body:
I was driving around with some friends. We were out to go blazertaging. (Smoking weed then going lazertaging.) We couldn't get any weed so one of my friends suggested going to his house. My other friend told us that he has a bunch of salvia we could do.
So we took turns taking salvia. I was second. First I hit the bowl to get any res that I could get from the last hit. Then my friend threw a hit of salvia in it. I took a hit and held it for about 40 seconds. I exhaled and my vision shattered before my eyes.
I exhaled and my vision shattered before my eyes.
Everything suddenly became unreal.
I quickly passed the bowl to my right and ran down the stairs and dove into a denim couch. I landed face first in between two cushions. As I was in the couch I kept yelling WOOAAH, WOAH. It felt as though I was trapped in a blue sea. Every time I turned my head I would only find more blue.
Eventually I slide off the side of the couch. And looked up at my friends standing a few feet away from me. I looked around an realized I was lost in the couch. I had no idea what was going on. I began to get scared because I was talking to my friends, but they would just whisper to themselves. Thoughts ran through my head. I began to think they were planning to jump me.  I sat back on the couch and one of my friends came near me. I just stared for a good minute. Then slowly pushed them away.
By now I was starting to come down. All in all it was a good experience.
